in_sanskrit.name: Sharash
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant, Golden, Shining
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharash एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharash means radiant, golden, shining. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shara', meaning king, ruler, lord, or leader. In Hindu mythology, Sharash is associated with the sun god, Surya, who represents power, strength, and vitality. The name is often given to boys born during the summer season or to those who are expected to become leaders and rulers in their lives.
